name: Title card — newspaper
description: Full-frame newspaper-style chapter title card. Display headline + mono dateline (JetBrains Mono, bottom of card). The card silhouette is TORN, not cropped — the Pack's structural edge Role (syntax newspaper.edge: torn) resolves through resolveEdgeTreatment into the shared edge-treatment ShaderPass, which carves the tear inward, grows the white interior fiber rim, and synthesizes the hard-offset shadow as an offset duplicate of the torn silhouette (aesthetic.md § Collage System / Cut behavior; the earlier 'clean printed edges' reading predated the edge primitive). Under a clean-cut Pack (editorial-mono) the same Preset renders a straight die-cut edge. Lean-out (a) brightness-reveal deliberately omitted — focal arrival is carried by halo-bloom-up + settled-place; brightness-reveal is reserved for spoken-content text. Lean-out (b) registration jitter n/a — no saturated marks. Lean-out (c) the title cap-height exceeds G4's Surface-title band (60–110 px) by design — with a dateLabel only, the title takes the Display-headline role the rubric doesn't yet codify (Critic-filed rubric-gap). Halftone + ink-bleed + mottling + edge-occlusion physics render on the newspaper Surface via its shaderPass per ADR-0008 (compose-pipeline invocation is wired). Halftone fires only on mid-tones, so it is correctly absent on this dark-headline-on-cream card; ink-bleed and paper mottling are visible. Verifies the newspaper Surface and washi-tape Overlay added by ADR-0008 / ADR-0009.
